summary: RTS-style controls on the expedition screen: the drawn portal lines, teal midpoint dots and the route legend are deleted, tiles tint by reachability, left-click selects and right-click orders a move, and hotkeys 1-9 and the route words issue the same order through the one request_travel path.

coordination.notes: Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at 2ec3243. Godot-only lane: no Rust, no port, no campaign_session.gd, no content. draw_portal and its midpoint dot are deleted rather than hidden -- move 3, the feature goes -- and the reachability the lines used to carry becomes a tint on the tile, which is the same snapshot fact drawn once instead of twice. Legality stays where it is: the native legal_route_commands list is the only judge, and portal_to_cell is a lookup inside that list, not a second check. The route board owns the cell-to-portal mapping because it already builds the catalog portal list; the prototype asks it rather than keeping a second copy. request_travel remains the single path to the bridge -- the words, the right-click and the hotkey all end in it -- and the mouse and key handlers call the same test hooks a suite calls, so there is one code path per order and not two.
